detail.longDescription: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.
